cases.name: Aaliyah Renee Williams
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Aaliyah attended Broken Arrow Freshman Academy. She graced us with her beautiful voice, which she shared through the choir of her previous school. Not only did she sing but showed interest in track. Most people also knew her love for cooking especially when she was joined by her great-grandmother. She was always happy and grateful to get new kitchen equipped to try out new recipes. She thrived in the kitchen. Just recently cooking the Thanksgiving dinner with her great-grandmother. There’s no doubt that she was sassy, but he was hilarious, compassionate to everyone, with a smile that could light up the room. Aaliyah was a devoted daughter and sister, loving granddaughter, niece, aunt, and cousin to her family. As well as an exceptional friend."
